title: Non-gazetted staff of five new GMCs resume indefinite strike over delay in recruitment rules

ai.summary: Non-gazetted staff of five new GMCs in Jammu and Kashmir resumed an indefinite strike for the third time this year, protesting a seven-year delay in recruitment rules notification. Healthcare services at GMC Rajouri were severely impacted with postponed surgeries.

facts.claim: Non-gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) across Jammu and Kashmir on Monday resumed their indefinite strike for the third time this year
facts.quote: Non-Gazetted cadre employees of five newly established Government Medical Colleges (GMCs) across Jammu and Kashmir on Monday resumed their indefinite strike for the third time this year, protesting the prolonged delay in notification of their recruitment rules.

facts.claim: They have been awaiting notification of the recruitment rules for the past seven years
facts.quote: The employees have been awaiting notification of the recruitment rules for the past seven years.

facts.claim: Two strikes had already been held this year, following which a meeting was convened in August with Health Minister Sakina Itoo, who had assured that the rules would be notified by September 30
facts.quote: They said two strikes had already been held this year, following which a meeting was convened in August with Health Minister Sakina Itoo, who had assured that the rules would be notified by September 30.

facts.claim: The deadline passed without any notification, prompting the employees to resume their protest
facts.quote: However, the deadline passed without any notification, prompting the employees to resume their protest.

facts.claim: The delay had left their career progression uncertain, as they were neither getting promotions nor were fresh recruitments being conducted
facts.quote: The protesting employees said the delay had left their career progression uncertain, as they were neither getting promotions nor were fresh recruitments being conducted.

facts.claim: They are demanding immediate notification of recruitment rules for all Non-Gazetted cadre employees of the five new GMCs in Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: They are demanding immediate notification of recruitment rules for all Non-Gazetted cadre employees of the five new GMCs in Jammu and Kashmir.

facts.claim: The strike has severely affected healthcare services, leaving patients and their attendants facing difficulties at government hospitals
facts.quote: Meanwhile, the strike has severely affected healthcare services, leaving patients and their attendants facing difficulties at government hospitals.

facts.claim: At GMC Associated Hospital Rajouri, several elective surgeries scheduled months in advance were postponed on the first day of the strike, while OPD and IPD services were also affected
facts.quote: At GMC Associated Hospital Rajouri, several elective surgeries scheduled months in advance were postponed on the first day of the strike, while OPD and IPD services were also affected.

facts.claim: Medical Superintendent of GMC Associated Hospital Rajouri, Dr Shamim Ahmed, confirmed that healthcare services had been hit, particularly elective surgeries, which had to be suspended due to the strike
facts.quote: Medical Superintendent of GMC Associated Hospital Rajouri, Dr Shamim Ahmed, confirmed that healthcare services had been hit, particularly elective surgeries, which had to be suspended due to the strike.

ai.background_note: Non-gazetted staff of five new GMCs in Jammu and Kashmir have been striking for seven years over delayed recruitment rules, with healthcare services severely impacted.
